terms.digest_match: observed bytes produce the expected digest under the declared hash algorithm
terms.integrity: bytes are unchanged relative to a trusted reference digest or equivalent integrity evidence
terms.provenance: declared and evidenced information about source, history, transformation, and custody
terms.authorship: identity of the person or entity that created or issued the artifact
terms.authentication: evidence that binds an asserted identity or authority to an artifact
terms.digital_signature: a cryptographic signature verified with an identified key and algorithm
terms.content_truth: whether claims contained in the artifact are correct

required_wording.sha256_match: byte identity verified against the stated SHA-256 digest
required_wording.signature_absent: no digital-signature claim may be made without signature evidence
